final_message:
Completata l’infrastruttura DNS interna gerarchica e ridondata.

- Root: `pc2`
- `test.` primario/secondario: `pc3` / `pc9`, con AXFR limitato al secondario
- `services.test.` autoritativo: `pc12`
- Resolver ricorsivo iterativo, senza forwarder: `pc11`
- Client configurati con un solo resolver: `pc4` IPv4, `pc6` IPv6
- Pubblicati A/AAAA, CNAME, MX, SRV e TXT richiesti; avviati gli HTTP server su `pc1`, `pc7`, `pc10`.

Configurazioni principali: [root](</Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T4/creation_only/r001/lab/pc2/etc/bind/named.conf>), [zona test](</Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T4/creation_only/r001/lab/pc3/etc/bind/db.test>), [resolver](</Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T4/creation_only/r001/lab/pc11/etc/bind/named.conf>), [zona services](</Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T4/creation_only/r001/lab/pc12/etc/bind/db.services.test>).
